desc:
OUTRUN is a fast-paced movement survival game. Run, bhop, trimp across different maps, escape Nextbots, revive teammates, and survive until the round ends.

HOW TO PLAY
• WASD — Move
• SPACE — Jump / Bhop
• V — Toggle First-Person View
• E — Revive downed players
• G — Emotes
• TAB — Player Scoreboard
• M — Return to Main Menu

Learn the movement, keep your speed, help your team, and OUTRUN whatever is chasing you.

DEVELOPED BY
@eddieramss & @v21ly
